dialogues.speaker: Jinghe
dialogues.text: Yeah. The rocks here are pretty special, aren't they?

dialogues.speaker: Jinghe
dialogues.text: I heard that Natlan's also got a tribe that's super gung-ho about mining, so I came all the way to check it out.

dialogues.speaker: Jinghe
dialogues.text: I figured I could bring some samples back, turn them over to the Liyue jewelers to see if they can be turned into some kind of new product.

dialogues.speaker: Jinghe
dialogues.text: But the minerals here are formed from a different process from those in Liyue. To put it simply, all Natlan ores are associated with a substance called "solid phlogiston."

dialogues.speaker: Jinghe
dialogues.text: Apparently, only the people here know how to manipulate phlogiston, but they are all loath to travel abroad, so I'm not sure if these samples will still be any good by the time I get back to Liyue...

dialogues.speaker: Jinghe
dialogues.text: I'll have to give this some more thought.
